changes.title: Discord office: a channel per department, text the office
what: The office bot makes its own channels in your Discord server: #chief-of-staff, #ask-the-office, #watchlist, #metals, #risk, #website-and-data, #engineering, #hr-and-innovation.
Each 7:00 am and 4:30 pm report posts to the right department channel. Saturday reviews post to #hr-and-innovation.
Text #ask-the-office (status, watchlist, metals, clock, risk, website, engineering, or a ticker) and Morgan replies within about 10 minutes.
Change requests post in #engineering. Reply APPROVED or DENIED and it's logged.
Only the server owner (you) gets answers.
